summary: Frontend-only re-test for F2F48 Studio iteration 2 (logo image in header, mode-toggle visual differentiation, bulk B-roll prompts model, per-scene source pills, storyboard source badges, removed Add Scene / Pick Footage). Backend was intentionally not re-tested per request (no backend changes since iteration 1). All 30 frontend scenarios covering the new features passed end-to-end including a full Faceless render → complete with sample MP4. No bugs found.
critical_code_review_comments: Studio.jsx is ~565 lines and approaching the recommended 700-line ceiling; consider splitting the Faceless scene block (bulk prompts + scene list + storyboard) into its own component in a future refactor.

Scene cap logic in the textarea onChange truncates input mid-typing. Works correctly but UX could show a small 'Maximum 12 scenes reached' toast/inline notice when extras are dropped. Currently silent.

BRoll source change handler clears every per-scene override even when switching between two non-mix sources (e.g. pexels → pixabay). Intentional per spec ('the overrides are cleared so the new default takes hold across all scenes') but worth double-confirming with product.

render polling interval (1500ms) and lack of exponential backoff/cleanup-on-unmount is fine for DRY_RUN but for live renders an unmount-cleanup is already in place via pollRef + useEffect return; good.

success_rate.backend: 100% (15/15) — carried over from iteration 1, not re-run
success_rate.frontend: 100% (~30 scenarios across logo+theme, mode toggle data-mode attrs, bulk-prompts textarea, scene auto-creation, scene-count text, 12-scene cap, default/global/mix source pill resolution, per-scene overrides, hint text per source, scene-pick visibility, storyboard source badges Px/AI/Pb, removed buttons sanity, generate validation in mix mode, full faceless render→complete with history row)
